name: 町内会馆

parameters.prompt: An asymmetric traditional neighbourhood clubhouse with two connected gables, sheltered veranda, carved timber brackets and a small red lantern. Japanese small-town miniature, readable front entrance facing +Z. Warm timber frames, cream plaster, blue-grey kawara tiles, shoji lattice windows, subtle red or sage noren. Rich handmade details, softly faceted low-poly forms, light matte materials. One complete exterior, flat grounded base, no interior, landscape, people, text, floating parts or baked shadows. Follow the two reference views for proportions, enrich the architecture. Footprint about 4 by 3.5 units, height under 4.2.

adoption: accepted after front, rear and side visual review; scene integration remains separate

inspection.notes: Complete miniature exterior, no visible major holes or detached parts.
